page.layout: One printed page, right-hand page of the opening. Running head at top centre-left with page number 67 at top right. Main text in one column of running paragraphs with numbered paragraphs (I.–VIII.) and a signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: I. Vt literas ego vestras legi, Viri amplißimi, Domini obseruantia perpetua colendi, quibus honestissimo liberalissimoq; stipendio oblato mecum agebatis, meam vobis operam vt addicerem, incredibili profecto sum læetitia affectus.

II. Etenim, si Demosthenem illum Atheniensem aquam ferentis mulierculæ delectatum sufurro fuisse legimus, quid mihi, homini, nec ab ingenio, nec doctrina magna instructo animi esse putatis, qui tot ac tantorum virorum egregiam in me voluntatem, præclarum de studiis factum iudicium intelligo.
III. Equidem iam ante inaudieram, uos pro vestra singulari pietate ac sapientia de literarum ludis restaurandis eandemq; ad rem viris accersendis doctis consilia tractare.
IIII. Eam vero ad rem me aptum atq; idoneum iudicatum iri, nunquam credidissem.
V. Itaque quo magis præter spem hoc meam & expectationem accidit, eo plus vestro me debere amori agnosco, qui scilicet ad me vocandum vos impulit.
VI. Atq; vtinam is ego essem, qui vestram aliorúmq; de me, concitatam existimationem sustinere possem.
VII. Sed novi ego meo me pede metiri: quàm angusta mihi sit accísaq; eruditionis supellex, scio.
VIII. Voluntatem forte & conatum quantulum-cunq; bene de adolescentiū studiis merendi profiteri

page.notes: Woodcut-free page. Doubtful readings: "aliorúmq;" in paragraph VI (the accent over the u may be a printer's mark; the word is likely "aliorumq;"). Paragraph numbers are printed as Roman numerals with full stops; the printed numeral for the eighth paragraph is "VII." in the scan, which appears to be a printing error for VIII. and is left as printed in the text above. Long s transcribed as s. The first line of the page is a continuation of the previous page's sentence in the prefatory address; no cont="true" flag applies since the paragraph opens with a numeral.
